label: run80 coal tuning
definition: Run 80: the run79 keeper config revalidated unchanged on post-E3 main (reproduces run79 in every class-year). The coal-tuning probes it anchors were net-negative and reverted: a lignite price sweep ($1.45 measured vs $1.15/$1.05 marginal-cost probes, bundles run80b/c) trades 2023 against 2024 and bleeds PRB share, and PRB sigmoid floor/shape probes (run80d/e) cannot discount 2024 without overshooting 2023 (their monthly gas ranges overlap). The real PRB residual is per-plant: W A Parish and J K Spruce under-run in all years incl. 2025.
